'''''Star Wars: The Rise of Kylo Ren''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Charles Soule]] and drawn by [[Will Sliney]]. The story explores the backstory of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and the [[Knights of Ren]]. The four-part series began on [[December 18]], [[2019]].
